name: Jabberwock — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Jabberwock from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Jabberwock, Lesser" but are not part of the Jabberwock entry, which is unchanged.

Weaknesses fear of vorpal weapons, vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 80 ft. (poor)
Melee bite +34 (4d8+11/17–20/×3), 2 claws +34 (3d6+11/19–20 plus grab), tail slap +29 (2d8+16), 2 wings +29 (1d8+5)
Ranged 2 eye rays +24 touch (15d6 fire plus burn)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks burble, burn (6d6, DC 30), eye rays, whiffling

Skills Acrobatics +26 (+30 jump), Escape Artist +26, Fly +21, Intimidate +32, Perception +33
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, Sylvan
SQ planar acclimation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Burble (Su)
